categories_thin: Dental specialists: only general dentists and one pediatric practice - no orthodontist, oral surgeon or endodontist with a Cranbury office (residents use Monroe/East Windsor practices).
Accounting and tax: several solo CPAs found, but almost all with directory-only evidence and no firm website.

Retail (non-food): Cranbury village has very few shops - about six boutiques, a florist and a bike shop; no hardware, furniture, appliance or jewelry store inside the township (Home Depot on Station Rd is a chain and excluded).

Tutoring, dance and art schools: essentially none of their own in Cranbury; the providers that 'serve Cranbury' are based in Monroe, East Windsor, South Brunswick or West Windsor and fall outside the zone.
Medical doctors: most physicians at Cranbury addresses belong to large health systems (Penn Medicine etc.) and were excluded, so the independent-practice count is very low.

Roofing, siding, windows, flooring, painting, pest control, cleaning and restoration: nearly all companies ranking for 'Cranbury' are based in neighbouring towns and merely list Cranbury as a service area, so few genuine in-zone businesses exist.
caveats: Cranbury Township sits right at the 10-mile edge of the Milltown radius (centre to village centre is roughly 10 miles), so the village core is inside but the southern Route 130 / Half Acre Rd industrial belt may fall just outside - analysts should check coordinates per address.

The 08512 ZIP spills into East Windsor, Plainsboro, Monroe and South Brunswick. Entries here have Cranbury / Cranbury Township addresses in the source, but some 'Cranbury, NJ 08512' businesses are physically in East Windsor or Monroe (e.g. 379 Princeton-Hightstown Rd, 294 Applegarth Rd, 300 Princeton-Hightstown Rd) and were excluded.

Cranbury has an unusually large industrial, distribution and life-science base relative to its tiny village core; many of those sites are branch offices of national or multinational firms. Those over the 500-staff or chain threshold were excluded, and the remaining ones are flagged in their notes.

Several accounting, salon and manufacturing entries come from bulk directories (njbusinessdirectory.org, MerchantCircle, bizarchive) that may carry stale records; active_evidence says 'one directory only' where that is the case.

Franchise/brand locations excluded even where locally operated: T&T Coast GMC (car dealer), Minuteman Press Cranbury, Roto-Rooter, SERVPRO of Old Bridge/Cranbury, Extra Space Storage, Home Depot, State Farm (Shilpa Rathi), Allstate (Sangeeta Malik), RE/MAX Select, Callaway Henderson Sotheby's, Staybridge Suites / Hampton Inn / TownePlace Suites.

Excluded as large institutions, health systems or government: Penn Princeton Primary Care Cranbury, L'Oreal USA, Taro Pharmaceuticals, Biocon Generics, CMIC CMO, Palatin Technologies, Stada, Kronos, Mercury Marine, Associated Press, SanMar, Anixter, Crate & Barrel distribution, Prologis Park, First Constitution Bank, Cranbury Township Public Works, Trans-Atlantic Renal Council.
A second 'Cranbury Dental Clinic' site (cranburydentalcare.com, phone 732-390-9093) was found but shows no address, so it was left out rather than guessed into the zone.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap / Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (two endpoints timed out or aborted), so no OSM-based sweep was possible.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Cylex, AllPages, Opendi, Hubbiz, Superpages and MapQuest all returned HTTP 403 (bot protection) to direct fetches; their content was used only through search-result snippets and category URLs, so per-business addresses could not be verified there.
Google Maps in the browser returned a 'limited view' of only about five results per category, so it was used to confirm individual listings rather than to enumerate the zone.
No Cranbury Chamber of Commerce member directory exists online; the township website's 'directory' is a municipal staff directory, not a business directory.
Phone numbers and street addresses marked 'Unknown' were not published on any page that could be opened; triage should pull them from the business's own site.
Street address is unpublished for Dan's Heating & AC, Conley Electric, Growing Concern, Alen Security, AE2 Learning, Cranbury Custom, M. Kaiser Building and R.A. Nichols - only the town is known.

The full roster of tenants in the Route 130 / Half Acre Rd / Prospect Plains Rd / Corporate Dr warehouse and life-science parks is not public; only firms that appear in directories or on their own sites are captured.
Knapp's Cyclery's Cranbury store status is ambiguous - a 2026 Patch feature describes the opening while a directory lists the shop as closed.
